# Caldence

> Caldence is a free, open-source web app (AGPL-3.0-or-later) for planning the recurring meetings of agile roles and teams (Product Owner, Scrum Master, developers; Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and exporting them as .ics files to Outlook, Google Calendar and Apple Calendar. It runs entirely in the browser: no account, no server-side processing, no tracking. Workspaces are saved as local JSON files.

Caldence is a static single-page app with a German and an English interface. It can be installed as an app and works offline. Anyone can host it: the release ZIP contains only static files.

Main features:

- Teams, people and roles with weekly working hours per team
- Recurring meeting rules: weekly, selected weekdays, every n weeks, monthly nth weekday, cadence day, cycle milestone, once
- Templates for Scrum, Kanban and SAFe, plus custom template files
- Calendar by week, month or the whole planning horizon, with public and school holidays (Saxony, Germany built in; other regions via region files)
- Load per person and role with warnings for unusually full weeks; optional meeting costs from an hourly rate
- Import and export of .ics calendar files
- Keyboard operation and screen reader support, light and dark mode, targeting WCAG 2.2 AA
